_about: Official DataforSEO prices after the 1 July 2026 price update, checked 2026-10-02. 'confirmed': false means the price is inferred, so every call asks Paul first (dfs.py exit 5) until he confirms it here. After real runs, `dfs.py ledger` flags any logged actual cost that differs from the estimate.

on_page/task_post.note: Results endpoints (summary, pages, links, duplicate_*, redirect_chains, non_indexable) are free for 30 days — summary confirmed in docs, the rest same pattern.

serp/google/organic/live/advanced.note: Per SERP of up to 10 results (depth 100 = 10 units). Search operators x5 each. Standard queue is $0.0006/unit.

serp/google/maps/live/advanced.note: Per SERP of up to 100 results. A 7x7 grid = 49 calls ~ $0.098 per keyword.

keywords_data/google_ads/search_volume/l.note: Per task of up to 1,000 keywords; billed per task, not per keyword.

dataforseo_labs/google/ranked_keywords/l.note: INFERRED: the page's 'All Other Endpoints' tier; endpoint not named. Up to 1,000 items per call = $0.132. Clickstream data doubles it.

dataforseo_labs/google/keyword_overview/.note: INFERRED: same tier as ranked_keywords. Each keyword is an item.

backlinks/summary/live.note: Per request + per row; no monthly minimum since 1 July 2026.

business_data/google/reviews/task_post.note: Standard queue, per 10 reviews of depth; +$0.00075 per task when using place_id or cid. Priority is $0.0015 per 10.
